Copernicus’s critics included Aristotelian philosophers, conservative Ptolemaic astronomers, and certain theologians who defended a stationary Earth.

Tycho Brahe later rejected the Copernican system and proposed a hybrid model in which the Sun moved around a fixed Earth.

Did Tycho Brahe and other astronomers challenge the physical reality of a moving Earth?

Were Aristotelian ideas about natural motion a major obstacle to acceptance?

How boldly Copernicus overturned the ancient order!

What a revolutionary vision his heliocentrism offered!
